cohort: 175 women who received a PPIUD following delivery at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College & Hospital (ShSMCH) in 2017 and were followed up after 2 years.
finding: The PPIUD had a continuation rate of 69.7% after 2 years, with the most common adverse event being menstrual irregularities and a low failure rate of 1.7%.
mod_finding: 85.71% of PPIUD insertions were performed during cesarean section, while 14.28% were after vaginal delivery.
